description: Everything we know about ONE address in one call: a wallet checker / address lookup. Each part is its own block: `ens` (reverse ENS name), `tags` (names attached to the address, e.g. a token's name), `labels` (per chain: entity and wallet type), `label_sources` (which source claimed what about the address, read for Ethereum; third-party providers are named provider_a to provider_e), `label_origins` (BNB Chain, Base, HyperEVM: the origins each chain's label records and what each claimed, `origin` one of third_party (provider_a), model (our heuristic, with its source, confidence (null = not scored) and tier), cross_chain (copied from the same address's label on `from_chain`) or unknown; a claim can differ from the label), `onchain` (transfer count per chain where the address is active), `code` (per chain, the code found at the address when last checked: contract, eip7702 delegated wallet, safe multisig or proxy; a chain absent means no code when checked, or not checked), `token` (name, symbol and chain when it is a token contract), `first_funder` (per chain: the earliest inbound coin and priced token transfers we hold, with sender and label; not proof of who funded the wallet), `exchanges` (per chain: the centralised exchanges it sent to and received from over 365 days, a lower bound), `hl_trader`, `hl_vault`, `hl_builder` (its Hyperliquid identity), `polymarket` (the Polymarket account at this address, its owner, and the accounts it owns), `predictfun` (its Predict.fun fills, counted up to 100,000, first and last trade in epoch ms, and its realized P&L and volume from the leaderboard once ranked; null when it never traded there), and `summary` (plain observed facts read off the blocks, never a verdict such as 'safe'). first_funder and exchanges cover every chain the address has transfers on, or only `chain`. A block missing from the answer could not be read; an empty one means we looked and found nothing. Use when the user pastes an address and asks 'whose wallet is this', 'what is this address' or 'check this wallet'; for one chain's funder or exchanges with other floors or windows, use wallet_first_funder / wallet_exchange_usage.

address.description: EVM address (0x-prefixed, 42 chars), a wallet or a contract

chain.description: Read first_funder and exchanges on this chain only (default: every chain the address has transfers on)

name: wallet_check
